scope: Event-mode overdue capacity retry and fail-closed capture-contract hardening; no native capture or efficacy claim

static_advance.finding: The pre-registered paired evaluator accepted two differently named model classes when both capture manifests referenced the same checkpoint hash, and it did not bind the config filename to the declared model class.
implementation: Require the config path stem to equal the declared model class.
Reject paired captures that reuse one checkpoint hash for baseline and candidate.
Add regression tests for both fail-closed conditions.

blocker.blocker: Authorized server-6 GPU7 capacity remains occupied by M197-PIRS plus one foreign process.
blocker.unblock_condition: M197-PIRS reaches terminal state or GPU7 has fewer than two processes with sufficient measured free memory.
blocker.alternatives_attempted: Rechecked live GPU capacity, performed one targeted process query, and advanced the static paired-capture contract without touching the active or foreign workloads.

limitations: The capture identities are validated structurally; they are not authenticated against an external signed manifest.
No paired native capture ran, so no P1/P2/P3 or efficacy result is claimed.
M197-PIRS remains prior-art engineering evidence and does not authorize a successor mechanism.
